attachment.desc: An attachment is any digital file linked to a specific data record to provide supplementary information or media. This could be a photograph of a specimen, a scanned permit document, a field notes PDF, or an audio recording. Instead of storing the file directly in the database, which would make it large and slow, Specify saves the file to a dedicated Web Asset Server and stores only a reference to that file in the database record.

copyrightdate.desc: Date of the copyright of attachment.
copyrightdate.name: Copyright Date

attachment.name: Attachment

method.desc: A method, such as net or trap, which is used to obtain the specimen.
method.name: Method

stationfieldnumber.desc: Legacy MUSIT Leg number on collecting event (use CollectionObject.fieldNumber)
stationfieldnumber.name: Collector no (Leg)

timestampcreated.desc: The timestamp the record was created.
timestampcreated.name: Timestamp Created

timestampmodified.desc: The timestamp the record was last modified.

verbatimdate.desc: Date which collector recorded in a field book, exactly as reported by the collector. It should indicate whether reported as a range, season, month, etc.
verbatimdate.name: Verbatim Date

catalogeddateverbatim.desc: The verbatim date the specimen was collected.
catalogeddateverbatim.name: Cataloged Date Verbatim

cataloger.desc: In Specify, the person who recorded the specimen data in the catalog. Cataloger records are stored in the Agent table.
cataloger.name: Cataloger

catalognumber.desc: The number that identifies an individual specimen, a lot of specimens, or an observation as a part of a museum collection.
catalognumber.name: Catalog Number

cojo.desc: Connects a Collection Object to its Collection Object Group
cojo.name: Parent Group

collectionobjecttype.desc: The type of object, such as a fish, mammal, mineral, rock, or meteorite.
collectionobjecttype.name: Type

deaccessioned.desc: True if the object has been deaccessioned.
deaccessioned.name: Deaccessioned

remarks.desc: MUSIT administrative notes, audit trail, and UUID
remarks.name: Adm note

text3.desc: Migration archive (JSON). Includes unmapped MUSIT fields, field-number resolution, and specimen/taxon/type literature strings.
text3.name: Migration archive (JSON)

timestampcreated.name: Timestamp Created

timestampmodified.desc: The timestamp the record was last modified.
timestampmodified.name: Modified Date

collector.desc: In Specify, the person or persons who collected a specimen. Collector records are stored in the Agent table.

ordernumber.desc: The position in the list of collectors.
ordernumber.name: Order Number

timestampcreated.desc: The timestamp the record was created.

timestampmodified.desc: The timestamp the record was last modified.

collector.name: Collector

determination.desc: Sometimes referred to as an ‘Identification’, this record captures the taxonomic name assigned to a Collection Object. It includes data such as the determiner (the person who identified it), the date it was determined, confidence qualifiers (like “cf.” or “?”), type statuses, and remarks. A single Collection Object can have a history of many Determinations over time.

addendum.desc: Sensu lato / sensu stricto suffix on the determination (MUSIT CLASSIFICATION_TERM.SENSU_TERM).
addendum.name: Sensu

alternatename.desc: A free text field for insertion of a name (scientific or common) not recognized in the taxon tree authority. This field operates as an "either/or" condition with Preferred Taxon; both cannot be entered in a single Determination.
alternatename.name: Alternate Name

determinationcitations.desc: Literature cited for this determination, including type publications.
determinationcitations.name: Citations

determiner.desc: Individual who assigned or made the decision regarding the taxonomic name of specimen. In some instances, determiner may be an organization or institute. In Specify, determiner information is stored in the Agent table.
determiner.name: Determiner

determiners.desc: One or more determiners involved in identifying the collection object.
determiners.name: Determiners

featureorbasis.desc: Body part, or characteristic used as the basis of a determination.
featureorbasis.name: Feature Or Basis

iscurrent.desc: Yes if the determination is considered the 'best' (maybe even one of the better).
iscurrent.name: Current

method.desc: Taxonomic tools and information on which a determination is based. These include professional expertise, published taxonomic keys, molecular DNA, or comparisons with previously cataloged specimens.
method.name: Method

modifiedbyagent.desc: Link to lookup table for Method.
modifiedbyagent.name: Modified By Agent

nameusage.desc: Used to describe the context of the name entered into the taxon or Alternate name fields.
nameusage.name: Name Usage

preferredtaxon.desc: Auto-derived accepted name from the taxon tree when Taxon is a synonym.
preferredtaxon.name: Accepted taxon name

qualifier.desc: A term to qualify the identification of the taxon name when doubts have arisen as to its identity or as a comparison to a given name (e.g. "cf." or "aff.").
qualifier.name: Qualifier

remarks.desc: Note attached to the classification / determination event.
remarks.name: Note

taxon.desc: Working identification — link to the taxon tree (source of truth).
taxon.name: Taxon

text1.desc: Original MUSIT entered classification term (legacy dump; not the working taxon).
text1.name: Entered taxon name

text2.desc: Original MUSIT valid classification term (legacy dump; not the working taxon).
text2.name: Valid taxon name

text4.desc: MUSIT infraspecific rank abbreviation (ssp., var., form., cv.).

typestatusname.desc: A picklist of all available type designations; Holotype, Paratype, Neotype. Specify ships with predetermined values that are editable for users.

datum.desc: Geodetic datum for decimal coordinates (MUSIT DATUM).
datum.name: Datum

elevationmethod.desc: The method used to determine the elevation.
elevationmethod.name: Elevation Method

geography.desc: Link to Country, State, County, WaterBody, Island, IslandGroup ... info.
geography.name: Geography

latlongaccuracy.desc: Coordinate uncertainty radius in meters (MUSIT PRECISION)
latlongaccuracy.name: Coord precision (m)

latlongmethod.desc: the method used to determine the Latitude, Longitude
latlongmethod.name: Lat/Long Method

latlongtype.desc: The type of area described by the Latitude Longitude data (Point, Line, Rectangle)

localityname.desc: The full name of the locality.
